methodology_limitations: One previously exercised scenario with three deterministic variants, selected after a concrete v2 failure. This is a targeted regression diagnostic, not a fresh general benchmark.
No broad reliability or cross-model ranking conclusion follows from 3 trials per route.
Cloud provider calls are real, but calendar transport is synthetic and the database is disposable; no owner calendar/data changes.
The original v2 baseline retains its token-copy errors, missing UI controls and Unicode-preservation findings.
source_review: Frozen planner diff keeps owner-scoped proposal storage, encrypted payload/hash verification, owner/purpose/plan ID checks, existing expiry/revision/availability revalidation and committed receipt replay. No new blocker identified in this focused read.
